subject: Copywriting
title: Social Media as Micro Sales Letters
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Social Media as Micro Sales Letters.

hook.text: A viral tweet follows sales letter structure: hook (first line), proof (body), CTA (link).

buildup.text: Instagram carousels are multi-page sales letters. Swipe right = turn the page. Each slide builds desire.

discovery.text: TikTok creators use PAS (Problem-Agitate-Solve) in 60 seconds.

twist.text: Social platforms reward engagement, not sales.

climax.text: The best social sellers don't look like they're selling. The sales letter principles are invisible—felt, never seen.

punchline.text: Every viral post is a tiny sales letter. Same structure, new package.

quiz.question: How do Instagram carousels resemble sales letters?
options: Each slide builds desire like turning pages in a letter
